before.requirement: Reach a clean do_dump failure when traversal reaches JSON_PARSER_MAX_DEPTH.
before.reason: The complete old do_dump body has no depth limit rejection.

after.requirement: Reach the supported do_dump failure for a JSON value whose traversal reaches JSON_PARSER_MAX_DEPTH.
after.reason: The new guard returns failure at the limit. The API test supplies an array beyond the limit, but the harness sends only successfully parsed values to dumping. parse_value rejects values beyond the limit, while dump traversal begins one depth level lower than parsing. The harness has no other route to a deeper value.

claims.reason: The same depth limit tuple is absent from old do_dump and supported by new do_dump. The old harness cannot reach the new behavior because its only dumped objects come from the depth limited parser.
